parsed.explanation: Traveller-facing exposures are mixed. Positives: no trans-specific criminal offence, no documented birth-sex facility rule or entry-screening rule for visitors (the dossier says entry treatment is unsourced, so this is an open question), and a 2022 health-ministry ban on conversion practices. Negatives: a UN feature (Nov 2024) documents routine discrimination and ID-mismatch questioning of trans women at healthcare encounters, with stigma-driven violence risk, and no remedy is documented. Custody has a documented gap: no housing matches gender identity and trans prisoners are held in solitary or mixed wings, dated to 2015 with no later practice found. Discrimination protections are absent, and 2025 shows a Pride clampdown and arrests under vague penal articles. Violence is unquantified, so it is not assessed. The overall picture sits in the Elevated band: no criminalisation, but discrimination at scale in healthcare and an unremedied custody gap.
